operations.command: set -e; host=/etc/nixos/nix/hosts/{{arch}}/VM-TEST/VM-TEST.nix; sed -i '/settings.disk.immutability.mode =/a\  settings.sleep.hibernateOnSuspend = true;' "$host"; sed -i '/settings.disk.immutability.mode =/a\  boot.initrd.systemd.services.immutability.serviceConfig.StandardError = "journal+console";' "$host"; sed -i 's/\(boot.kernelParams = \[ "console=[^"]*"\) \]/\1 "ignore_loglevel" ]/' "$host"; grep -F ignore_loglevel "$host" >/dev/null; nixos-rebuild boot --flake /etc/nixos#VM-TEST-Standard-Boot; printf hibernation-configured

systemd-analyze cat-config systemd/sleep.conf | grep -Fx AllowHibernation=yes >/dev/null && systemctl cat systemd-suspend.service | grep -F 'systemd-sleep hibernate' >/dev/null && printf hibernation-allowed
set -e; echo hibernated-session > /root/e2e-hibernate-marker; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id > /var/tmp/e2e-hibernate-boot-id; sync; printf hibernate-armed

start=$(date +%s); while [ $(( $(date +%s) - start )) -lt 1200 ]; do test -s {{workDirShell}}/vm.exit && { echo $(( $(date +%s) - start )) >> {{workDirShell}}/sleep-seconds; printf powered-off; exit 0; }; sleep 1; done; exit 1
if grep -a -F -e 'first mount of filesystem' -e 'scanned by mount' -e 'Mode=reset' {{workDirShell}}/serial.log; then exit 1; fi; printf no-reset-before-resume
set -e; echo suspended-session > /root/e2e-hibernate-marker; sync; printf suspend-armed

start=$(date +%s); while [ $(( $(date +%s) - start )) -lt 1200 ]; do test -s {{workDirShell}}/vm.exit && { echo $(( $(date +%s) - start )) >> {{workDirShell}}/sleep-seconds; printf powered-off; exit 0; }; sleep 1; done; exit 1
if grep -a -F -e 'first mount of filesystem' -e 'scanned by mount' -e 'Mode=reset' {{workDirShell}}/serial.log; then exit 1; fi; printf no-reset-before-resume

set -e; if dmesg | grep -E 'BTRFS (error|critical)|transid verify failed|checksum verify failed|csum failed'; then exit 1; fi; btrfs scrub start -B / >/var/tmp/e2e-scrub.log 2>&1 || { cat /var/tmp/e2e-scrub.log; exit 1; }; printf scrub-clean

offset=$(cat {{workDirShell}}/reboot-serial-offset); tail -c +$((offset + 1)) {{workDirShell}}/serial.log | grep -a -F -e 'first mount of filesystem' -e 'scanned by mount' -e 'Mode=reset' >/dev/null && printf reset-visible-on-serial

set -e; if dmesg | grep -E 'BTRFS (error|critical)|transid verify failed|checksum verify failed|csum failed'; then exit 1; fi; btrfs scrub start -B / >/var/tmp/e2e-scrub.log 2>&1 || { cat /var/tmp/e2e-scrub.log; exit 1; }; printf scrub-clean
